name: NIK Parser
description: Privacy-aware structural NIK parsing, vision-model image extraction, and optional local document, portrait, signature, and custom-coordinate crops.
brief: Use this skill for privacy-aware structural NIK parsing and validation. It does not prove Dukcapil registration, ownership, active status, or identity.
author: Evonic

variables.name: ENABLE_IMAGE_PROCESSING
variables.label: Enable Image Processing
variables.description: Allow optional local OpenCV document and crop tools. Vision extraction does not require this setting.

variables.name: DEFAULT_VISION_MODEL_ID
variables.label: Default Vision Model
variables.description: Optional first enabled Evonic vision model to try. Empty selects automatically from the enabled vision-model list.

variables.name: FALLBACK_VISION_MODEL_ID
variables.label: Fallback Vision Model
variables.description: Second model tried after the default model fails. It must remain enabled and vision-capable.

variables.name: MAX_IMAGE_BYTES
variables.label: Maximum Image Size in Bytes
variables.description: Upload byte limit shared by vision extraction and local crop tools. A hard internal safety ceiling remains in force.

variables.name: MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS
variables.label: Maximum Image Pixels
variables.description: Requested decoded-image limit. A hard internal safety ceiling always remains in force.

variables.name: MIN_NIK_CROP_CONFIDENCE
variables.label: Minimum NIK Crop Confidence
variables.description: Confidence below this value should be manually reviewed.
